system.description:
You can mark a Stress to become an
Blackwall Host, allowing a rogue Al,
corrupted daemon, lost military
system, or forbidden Blackwall
fragment to partially pilot your body.
While in this form, gain the following:
All adversaries within Close range
must spend an additional Fear when
using a Fear feature.
When you defeat, disable, or
destroy a creature within Close
range, you absorb their final output
and clear a Hit Point.
You can mark a Stress to move to
any location within Very Far range,
ignoring difficult terrain, automated
security, and environmental
obstacles. This movement can't pass
through sealed barriers or spaces
with no plausible route.
Every time you make an action roll in
this form, you must spend a Hope. If
you can’t, the breach collapses and you
drop this form.
